_rule: The one contract two watchdogs implement: std/watchdog.js here (plain script, file:// safe) and src/watchdog/ in games/starfall (TypeScript). Both test suites read this file. A change here is a Change Request in both repos. OBS-02 keys, OpenTelemetry severity numbers, the event names a log reader may rely on.

behaviour.flush_on_error: a line at or above error_floor is written to the store at once
behaviour.ring: the store holds at most ring_size lines; the oldest go first
behaviour.hide_once: one app_hide per hide, however many events the browser fires
